[SWS_EthSM_00146] Transition from WAIT_ONLINE to ONLINE ⌈If EthSMTcpI-
pUsed is TRUE, in the state ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_ONLINE the state machine shall
have a transition to ETHSM_STATE_ONLINE, if the TcpIp modul reports TCPIP_
STATE_ONLINE for the corresponding network handle. If EthSMTcpIpUsed is FALSE,
in the state ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_ONLINE the state machine shall have a transition
to ETHSM_STATE_ONLINE unconditionally.⌋
Note: The transition is shown as sequence diagram in Figure 9.2.
